第44章 单行本问世-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

9月24号，《包氏父子》刚收工，就有人告诉刘济民，编辑李英来找他来了。
刘济民找到站在招待所等待的李英，带着他进了燕影厂的食堂。
“李编，您今天找我是干什么？”刘济民好奇地问道。
“对你来说是个好消息，《解放军文艺》社准备出版《归队》的单行本，所以我来跟你联系一下。”李英笑着说道，“单行本的发表，能进一步扩大《归队》的影响力，你说这是不是好消息？”
“这事儿啊，怎么是您来的？”刘济民笑着问道。
“杂志和出版一体办公，我来跟出版编辑来是一样的。正好有机会过来一趟，咱们两个还能聊聊天。”
李英将目前单行本出版的相关规定以及稿费规定都讲了一遍，刘济民答应了出版的请求。
“如今没有恢复印数稿酬，但是出版社觉得作家同志的创作不易，出于尊重知识的考虑，可以付基本稿酬加上百分之一的印数稿酬。”
除了四百块钱的基本稿酬外，每发行一万册还能获得定价的百分之一，也就是四块钱。
在版税出来之前，绝大多数作家单纯靠写作都是没办法养活自己的。
别说余桦等人了，就是鲁迅也养活不了自己啊。鲁迅作品以短篇和中篇为主，稿费本身就没多少。
李英聊完单行本的事情后，开始询问刘济民下一本小说，看他有没有什么思路。
“另外，我们编辑部来了一个年轻人，叫王硕，从海军那边借调过来的。有时间你们可以聊聊，你们年轻人之间话多，有的聊。今天本来想把他带来的，可惜临时被拉走了。”
“《等待》的作者吗？”
“你还记得他的作品啊，是他，我们看他有点潜力，就把他借调来工作了。”李英说完后，顿了顿，评价道，“这家伙有点混不吝，看到人后，我都后悔了！”
“哈哈哈。”刘济民闻言不禁笑出了声。
下午，《包氏父子》拍摄到包国维幻想和安淑珍在一起后，跳舞的片段。
朱霖找不到感觉，导致拍摄一直无法顺利进行，刘济民亲自上场带朱霖走戏。
“挽着我的胳膊，含情脉脉，对，眼神里多一点温柔。”刘济民慢慢引导着朱霖。

On September 24, as soon as "Bao and Sons" finished work, someone told Liu Jimin that editor Li Ying came to see him.
Liu Jimin found Li Ying who was waiting in the guest house and took him into the canteen of Yanying Factory.
"Editor Li, why are you looking for me today?" Liu Jimin asked curiously.
"It's good news for you. The People's Liberation Army Literature and Art Society is preparing to publish the single volume of "Return to the Army", so I'm here to contact you." Li Ying said with a smile, "The publication of the single volume can further expand the influence of "Return to the Army". Do you think this is good news?"
"Why are you here for this?" Liu Jimin asked with a smile.
"The magazine and publishing are integrated into one office. It's the same for me to come and the publishing editor to come. I just have the opportunity to come over and the two of us can chat."
Li Ying explained the current regulations on single book publishing and royalties, and Liu Jimin agreed to the request for publication.
"Currently, the royalties for print runs have not been restored, but the publishing house feels that it is not easy for writers to create. Out of respect for knowledge, they can pay the basic royalties plus one percent of the royalties for print runs."
In addition to the basic royalties of 400 yuan, you can also get 1% of the list price for every 10,000 copies published, which is 4 yuan.
Before royalties come out, most writers cannot support themselves simply by writing.
Not to mention Yu Hua and others, even Lu Xun couldn't support himself. Lu Xun's works are mainly short stories and novellas, and the royalties themselves are not much.
After Li Ying finished talking about the single book, he started asking Liu Jimin if he had any ideas for his next novel.
"In addition, there is a young man in our editorial department, his name is Wang Shuo, who is seconded from the Navy. You can chat when you have time. You young people talk a lot. We originally wanted to bring him here today, but unfortunately he was temporarily taken away."
"The author of "Waiting"?"
"You still remember his works? It's him. We saw he had some potential, so we seconded him to work." After Li Ying finished speaking, he paused and commented, "This guy is a bit generous. I regretted it when I saw him!"
"Hahaha." Liu Jimin couldn't help laughing when he heard this.
In the afternoon, "Bao and Son" filmed a clip of Bao Guowei fantasizing about dancing with An Shuzhen after being together.
Zhu Lin couldn't find the feeling, so the filming couldn't proceed smoothly. Liu Jimin personally took the stage to lead Zhu Lin in the scene.
"Hold my arm, be affectionate, yes, and have a little more tenderness in your eyes." Liu Jimin slowly guided Zhu Lin.
